name: CATS-VGA-12B
title: 1x12 VGA + Audio Over Cat5 Distribution Amplifier
description: 1x12 VGA and audio distribution amplifier over Cat5. Extends up to 1000 feet with stereo audio and S/PDIF support.
detailTitle: CATS-VGA-12B VGA Over Cat5 Distribution Amplifier
detailDescription: The CATS-VGA-12B distributes VGA video and audio to up to 12 remote displays over Cat5e cables at distances up to 1000 feet without loss or degradation. Supports resolutions up to WUXGA with stereo audio and S/PDIF digital audio.
features: Distributes VGA and audio up to 1000 feet without degradation
Supports stereo audio and S/PDIF digital audio
Adjustable equalization and gain control on receivers
De-skew compensation available with RX1D receiver
Scalable up to 16+ screens via daisy chaining
Two VGA and audio loop-outs for local displays
applications: Large retail stores and grocery stores
